AT.name: Kahler Schlangenkopf
AT.citation: Species-specific German horticultural name ("kahler" = hairless, matching glabra); shared DACH-region botanical vocabulary, no Austria-specific variant found

CA.name: White turtlehead
CA.citation: New England Wild Flower Society / Native Plant Trust plant finder, Chelone glabra

CA.name: Galane glabre
CA.citation: Database of Vascular Plants of Canada (VASCAN), Darbyshire et al. 2000, vernacular name record for Chelone glabra

DE.name: Kahler Schlangenkopf
DE.citation: Stauden Ratgeber horticultural reference, Chelone glabra listed as "Kahler Schlangenkopf, Schildblume"; distinguishes from Chelone obliqua ("Schiefer Schlangenkopf")

FR.name: Galane glabre
FR.citation: Consistent name across independent French sources (Willemse France, Promesse de Fleurs, homeopathic pharmacy pharmacie-homeopathie-generale.fr)

GB.name: Balmony
GB.citation: Royal Horticultural Society (RHS) plant record, Chelone glabra listed primarily as "balmony"

NL.name: Gladde schildpadbloem
NL.citation: NDFF Verspreidingsatlas (Netherlands national species distribution atlas), Chelone glabra listed as "Gladde schildpadbloem"; disambiguates from the genus-level "schildpadbloem" used inconsistently across species by Dutch commercial nurseries

US.name: White turtlehead
US.citation: Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center, Native Plant Database, Chelone glabra
